title: Chapter 99 Too Arrogant
content:
Chapter 99 Too Arrogant

Rumble!

Soon, countless powerful auras soared into the sky from the dragon clan.

Feeling the powerful abnormal movements from the dragon clan, the sentient beings in the world suddenly looked over with a serious expression.

He is indeed one of the overlords of the All Spirit Realm back then.

Even now, there is still such powerful energy.

At this time, there was a dragon in the Dragon Clan who was not that happy, but his face looked extremely ugly.

"Why is this happening? Why!!"

The ancestor of the Dragon Clan looked at his body without movement with horror. At this time, most of the people in the clan had already promoted blood, but they had no self.

Why didn't my bloodline respond?

Are you not a member of the Dragon Clan?

A deep sense of incomprehension filled my heart.

And in the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

Ao Qing slowly opened her eyes. At this time, Ao Qing's dragon eyes were no longer the ice blue color they used to be, but completely turned into brown.

An ancient aura slowly overflowed from his body.

The realm of God Lord!

Unexpectedly, Ao Qing was the first to reach the Divine Lord realm.

"Thank you, Master!"

After reacting, Ao Qing hurriedly thanked Lu Daosheng.

If it weren't for Lu Daosheng, he might have never been able to wake up again.

Even if you will not break through bloodlines, your realm will reach the realm of the Divine Lord.

At this time, Ao Qing not only had powerful bloodlines, but also had endless divine power.

Faced with the same level of the Divine Lord Realm, it is estimated that it will be difficult for the other party to break through Ao Qing's body, let alone defeat Ao Qing.

Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "Do you have no idea about the dragon clan in the All Spirit Realm?"

Hearing this, Ao Qing was silent for a moment and said slowly, "Master, I want to go back to the world of all spirits."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned.

Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Go, those things should be resolved."

Suddenly, Ao Qing's eyes were rosy and he nodded heavily.

"My little master, I'm leaving. When I'm not here, you must be small by yourself,"

Before he finished speaking, Lu Xue kicked him directly.

"Get out!"

Lu Xue's face turned pale and she said as if you were going to die.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Ao Qing smiled awkwardly, then hurriedly left here and headed towards the time and space tunnel.

Immediately, everyone in the deserted city saw a five-clawed divine dragon emitting divine light rising into the sky.

"Damn it! Am I dazzled? That dragon has five claws!!"

"Then, that seems to be Lord Ao Qing."

"Hiss, I am worthy of being a personal expert in protecting Miss Lu Xue, and my strength is so terrifying."

At the same time, An Xingwei and others also noticed Ao Qing's strength.

He actually reached the realm of the Divine Lord, one step faster than them.

They were jealous of seeing it.

"Oh, I have to work harder."

Everyone shook their heads and quickly continued to practice hard, striving to go further as soon as possible.

In the deserted city of All Spirits.

Although Awei and Anxing and others have left, the order in the deserted city is still safe and sound.

It depends on the space-time tunnel born from the time-space divine tower.

Once something happens in the desert city, the senior leaders of the desert city may come directly in the next second.

After the large population migration a few days ago, although there are still people entering the space-time tunnels now, it is already very rare.

In front of the space-time tunnel.

Two wild guards in the Heavenly Realm guards are here.

At the same time, it also takes into account the heavy responsibility of charging.

"grown ups."

At this time, a little thin young man came to the two of them.

Seeing this, the two frowned slightly.

"I said why are you here again? Didn't you say that? You can only get in after paying the fee. This is the rule."

Hearing this, the young man's face was obviously bitter, but he still gritted his teeth and begged, "Sir, the two of them are very kind. Let me in. I really can't make it here."

Hearing this, Huang Wei looked cold.

"Rules are rules. If you disrupt the order here, don't blame us for being punished."

Suddenly, a powerful aura surged out from the bodies of the two Huangwei.

In just a moment, the young man was shocked and retreated repeatedly.

I thought this would lead to the young man’s retreat, but what the two of them didn’t expect was that the young man pointed at their noses and said angrily: “Rules, rules, since you have managed so strictly, that’s the city Why don’t I care about it?”

As soon as these words came out, the two of them looked gloomy.

"What do you mean?"

The young man trembled all over, realizing that he had let go of his words, and quickly waved his hand.

"Nothing, nothing."

Immediately, the young man turned around and ran away as if he was about to leave.

Seeing this scene, the two looked at each other.

The next moment, the young man was easily subdued.

"Say, what the hell is going on?"

Seeing this situation, the young man looked ugly. With his strength, he naturally could not compete, not to mention that this was a Huangwei.

Who dares to mess with it?

As a last resort, he finally explained what he knew.

......

"What! Casino?!"

A Huangwei said in shock.

As we all know, as early as when the deserted city was first established, the city lord ordered that the casino was banned.

There are three things like pornography, gambling and drugs. In addition to Huanghuang City’s loose management, gambling and drugs have always been the strictest management of Huangcheng City.

But now, the young man actually said that a casino was opened in the outer city.

And he went to gamble and lost everything. Now he is not only penniless, but also in huge debt. He had no choice but to flee to another new wasteland city to get rid of all these and start over.

The expressions of the two wasteland guards changed.

"Are you serious?"

Hearing this, the young man looked a little desperate, "Really, of course it's true, and the owner of the casino has a very high status in the wasteland city. People like us can't afford to offend him."

"Of course, let alone people like us, even you wasteland guards can't afford to offend him."

Hearing this, the two were shocked.

The other party was so arrogant? !

Even our wasteland guards can't afford to offend?

Haha.

Immediately, the two sneered.

Can't afford to offend, right? Then I want to see if our leader can afford to offend him.

Their leader is a popular person around the city lord, with a high position and power.

"You stay here, I'll report it."

"Okay."

Then one of them turned around and used the communication treasure to send a message.

After receiving a reply a moment later, he stepped directly into the space-time tunnel.

At the original place, another guard continued to guard quietly, but glanced at the space-time tunnel from time to time.

As for the young man, when he saw the guard stepping into the space-time tunnel, he immediately showed a barely perceptible smile.

Can't afford to offend the guards?

That was of course false. He did this just to arouse the strength of the guards so that he could knock the other party down in one fell swoop.

Because the other party really has some strength and status in the deserted city.

Dare to cheat me and make me lose all my money.

In this case, let's not play.

Just as he was secretly gloating here, the space-time tunnel suddenly trembled violently.

Seeing this scene, the guards on the side trembled all over.

What a strong breath!

Could it be the leader?

But it was too fast.

Just as he was wondering, a huge monster suddenly rushed out of the space-time tunnel.

In an instant, a terrifying aura continued to pour down from the huge monster.

In a moment, the entire deserted city and even the entire world of all spirits felt this terrifying aura.

That is, a dragon!!

No, why does he have five claws? !
